saw_lines: Exam students don’t buy on hype. They compare test series and daily practice, then enrol when the deadline feels close.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a student decides whether this batch is worth the fee.
Your 3 of 3 copy ads run one identical copy, so each new student sees the same pitch. Keep the copy, change the opening line and creative in each.
